standard.summary: event 使用 CUDA events 延迟同步
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.event: CUDA event 记时间，对训练打扰小。
optionDescriptions.sync: 硬同步计时，准，但拖慢训练。

standard_en.summary: event uses CUDA events with deferred synchronisation
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.event: Times with CUDA events, which disturbs training little.
optionDescriptions.sync: Times with a hard synchronisation: accurate, but it slows training.

advanced.principle: event 使用 CUDA events 延迟同步；sync 保留旧全局同步计时；off 忽略 profiling。

advanced_en.principle: event uses CUDA events with deferred sync; sync keeps the legacy global-synchronization timing; off ignores profiling.
